question: How do the declared 3D local fluid conditions evolve when the bare diffusivity of the I conformation and the unstructured initial conformation population vary?
motivation_from_frozen_v01_map: At mu=-4 and saddle fraction .5, increasing df from -1.2 to 2.4 reduces the late B fraction from about .995 to .872 yet increases final coarse density variance at T300 in all three seeds. At the common saddle, variance instead decreases. This is a finite-time observation, not a qualified discovery or a steady-phase claim.
physical_law: Same H=df*N_B+epsilon*N_BB, passive B<->I, driven B+F<->I+W, local hard-core exclusion and rate ratios as v01. Every history starts at t=0.
changed_physical_assumption: Allow independent positive bare state diffusivities D_B and D_I. A hop rate is D_state/(2d) times exp(epsilon*nB_source) for B, and D_I/(2d) for I. State is unchanged during a hop so each forward/reverse ratio still equals exp(-DeltaH). These are declared molecular-friction parameters, not inside/outside or protection rules.
initial_change: Exactly floor(initial_B_fraction*M) B conformers on uniformly random occupied sites. Default .5 reproduces v01; frozen .995/.872 populations are explicit input controls, not discovered compositions or completed structures.

primary_3d.cases: all ten, 60 histories; each duration is a fresh t=0 run

validation_first: default equal-diffusion path agrees byte-for-byte with v01 at same seed
different-state diffusivities preserve the exact finite-system canonical distribution at mu0
one-particle hopping with either frozen conformation follows its own diffusion coefficient
frozen custom initial populations conserve all molecules and B states
all independent neighbor counts and H/work/medium-entropy ledgers remain valid
observation_only_change: Record full particle states every 50 time units in addition to original quarter/half/end checkpoints, without consuming random numbers. No physical parameter changes during a run. Density histories and two-time ID retention are observer readouts, not a controller.

fixed_readouts.time_dependence: entire recorded size/variance histories, no favorable endpoint-only selection
fixed_readouts.comparisons: paired seeds, both df values, I-only versus all-state mobility changes, common-saddle controls, frozen composition controls, physical volume and duration

counting: Original three-distinct-findings contract unchanged. A possible kinetic inversion remains F until controls settle its cause and material-compartment relevance. Different settings of the same instability, input population values, diffusion-rate algebra, and known equilibrium/phase-separation checks do not fill the quota.
limitations: hypothetical contact/saddle/friction parameters, not identified-molecule chemistry
implicit overdamped bath and ideal chemical-work reservoirs
heat column is generalized medium entropy flow, not calorimetry
molecular lattice spacing is physical; N controls volume, not continuum resolution
no membrane, selective-permeability, life or rung promotion without independent evidence
no_touch: v01 code, registration and every result
